notes.title: Kimchi: A Stars in the Trash Story is now available for FREE
notes.content: [p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3835170/Kimchi_A_Stars_in_the_Trash_Story/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]This International Cat Day, prepare to be whisked away! [i]Kimchi: A Stars in the Trash Story[/i] is a free, bite-sized puzzle-platformer set in the world of [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1822240/Stars_In_The_Trash/"]Stars in the Trash[/url][/b], where you play as Kimchi the curious kitten, exploring a Cat History Museum.[/p][p][/p][p]From prowling the sands of ancient Egypt to tiptoeing through feudal Japan, this short and sweet catventure is the purrfect treat for cat lovers, gamers, and anyone in need of a little heartwarming whisker magic.[/p][p][/p][p]Want a quick guide through the museum? ​ Check it out [b][url="https://valhallacats.com/cats-through-history/"]HERE[/url][/b]![/p][p][/p][p]Download and assemble your own Kimchi paper toy [b][url="https://valhallacats.com/wp-content/uploads/PaperToy-Kimchi-scaled.png"]HERE[/url][/b].[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="ohhHHxINQHI;full"][/previewyoutube]
